title: Send an investor update
summary: On the company's agreed investor reporting cadence or when a material update is due. A fact-checked update delivered to the authorized investor group, with requests and follow-up owned.
outcomes: A fact-checked update delivered to the authorized investor group, with requests and follow-up owned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: On the company's agreed investor reporting cadence or when a material update is due.

parts.title: Confirm the audience and reporting commitments
parts.guidance: List current investor contacts, contractual information rights, agreed cadence and confidentiality restrictions. Separate the broad investor update from board-only, lender or legally sensitive reporting.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assemble reconciled metrics and material developments
parts.guidance: Collect cash, runway, revenue, customer, hiring and product evidence for the reporting period. Define metrics consistently, flag estimates and reconcile changes from previous reports.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Draft the update and specific requests
parts.guidance: Summarize progress against prior commitments, setbacks, risks and the next priorities. State concrete help requests and distinguish a management forecast from a committed result or financing offer.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the content and recipients
parts.guidance: The founder and designated finance or legal reviewer check accuracy, material omissions, confidentiality and recipient permissions. Resolve sensitive issues through the appropriate governance process before distribution.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Deliver the approved update and assign responses
parts.guidance: Send the approved version through the agreed channel and retain the recipient list privately. Track introductions, questions and commitments with owners rather than treating delivery as completion of the follow-up work.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Deliver the approved update and assign responses

verify.how: A fact-checked update delivered to the authorized investor group, with requests and follow-up owned.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
